description:
Jeong Hae-Deun, a former high school competitive swimmer, now lives a quiet life working at a local swim center. His world is upended when Han Si-O appears, spinning a desperate web of lies about a career-ending leg injury that supposedly prevents him from ever swimming again. Moved by pity and a shared history, Hae-Deun falls for the deception and allows Si-O to move into his home. 

However, Si-O’s motives are far from innocent. Having harbored a dark, obsessive crush on Hae-Deun for years, he views this cohabitation as the ultimate opportunity. Si-O relentlessly pushes boundaries, his subtle manipulations eventually giving way to raw, unfiltered lust. He no longer hides his true nature, whispering feverish, provocative desires to his senior: "I want to spend all day tangled with you, kissing you... I want to sink into you and fill your inside with nothing but me."

(Source: Lezhin US)
